description: PasPet L2 part art. Grayscale 8-bit PNGs: pixel value 0 = transparent, 1..255 = shade ramp (low = outline, high = belly highlight). Layer content is authored inside the 64x64 grid; runtime blits x2 onto a 128x128 canvas, so all layers share one anchor. Per-part frames live in parts/<slot>/<NN>/<frame>.png; f0 is the resting pose and extra frames animate per designs 05 §5.3.

frame_notes.eyes: 0 variant normal, 1 blink, 2 happy arcs, 3 sleep arcs, 4 sick plus
frame_notes.face: 0 variant normal, 1 eating open mouth, 2 crying
frame_notes.head: 0 single frame
